question: Which of the following is **not **a good conductor of electricity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Diamond.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the options, only diamond is NOT a good conductor of electricity**__.
 
• **Diamond** is a naturally-occurring solid.
 __
 
• It is a mineral composed of **pure carbon.**
 
• Diamond is the smallest mass element capable of forming a stable covalently bonded crystal lattice with a highly symmetric and tightly bound structure.
 
• Diamond does not conduct electricity, is a **good electrical insulator.**
 
 
• Pure diamond is unable to conduct electricity because it lacks any delocalized free electrons in the carbon atom's outer shell.
 
 
 
• Diamond is a good **conductor of heat **due to its strong covalent bonding and low phonon scattering.
 
• All of the carbon atoms in the diamond lattice are **sp³ hybridized.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Graphite** is a crystalline form of carbon with its atoms arranged in a hexagonal structure.

 
 
• Graphite is a good conductor of electricity.
 
 
 
• **Gold** is a chemical element with the **atomic number 79**.
 
 
• Gold is a good conductor of both electricity and heat.
 
 
 
• **Soils** are electric current conductors.
